mode: add(infer=False) verbatim, no LLM, bge-m3 1024-d embeddings, local on-disk Qdrant, mem0 hybrid search (semantic + BM25 + entity), default threshold/limit for deployed
how: Memory.from_config(embedder=openai-compatible bge-m3, vector_store=qdrant path, llm=deepseek); Memory.add(text, user_id='bench', infer=False, metadata={'source_id': id, 'date': date}) per memory; Memory.search(q, filters={'user_id':'bench'}, top_k=10, threshold=0.0) for ranked; Memory.search(q, filters={'user_id':'bench'}) with mem0 defaults (top_k=20, threshold=0.1) for deployed
notes: mem0ai 2.2.1; extras: mem0ai[nlp] (spaCy en_core_web_sm for BM25 lemmatization and entity extraction, an English-only model applied to Chinese text) and fastembed Qdrant/bm25 sparse vectors, as the docs describe for hybrid search.
Each memory was added as one user message; metadata source_id=<memory id> and date were attached. No source/kind fields were given to mem0.

ranked: search top_k=10 threshold=0.0 (no threshold); deployed: search with mem0 defaults (top_k=20, threshold=0.1, no rerank); ms times the deployed call only. Items are mapped to source memories via the source_id metadata of the hit; one item per memory (best score kept).
infer=False path: no entity linking happens at write time, so the entity-boost part of mem0's scoring has no data; this is mem0's real behaviour for infer=False.
